linkedin.title: Personalised news is currently broken.
linkedin.body:
Most news apps today rely on simplistic algorithms that just feed you more of what you already clicked on. It creates an echo chamber rather than a window into the world. You end up reading the same perspective over and over again, which is the opposite of being informed.

At Headlinne, we are building something different. The roadmap for the next generation of news isn't about feeding you more of the same. It is about nuance. We are working on AI that helps you understand the full context of a story, not just the headline that gets the most clicks. Our goal is to connect the dots between complex events so you can see the bigger picture.

True personalisation should challenge your assumptions, not confirm them. It should give you the time back you spend scrolling by delivering the essential facts first. We want to move past the noise and focus on quality, depth, and genuine understanding.

story_card.headline: Audi to build its first US factory in Georgia
story_card.standfirst: The German automaker is investing $4 billion despite major challenges back home.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Audi plans to build a $4 billion SUV factory in the US. The project will create 4,500 new jobs.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Parent company Volkswagen is facing high tariffs, tough Chinese competition and high EV costs.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The move comes even as Volkswagen is cutting jobs in Germany to deal with financial struggles.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Watch how Volkswagen balances this US expansion with its ongoing restructuring in Germany.

story_card.caption:
Volkswagen is building a new Audi factory in the United States while cutting jobs in Germany.

The automaker is navigating a difficult landscape, balancing high costs for electric vehicles with pressure from Chinese competitors and new tariffs. This $4 billion investment in Georgia marks a major shift in their global strategy.
